quarterly_data.quarter: Qnity Electronics press release: Qnity Introduces New Kalrez High-Temperature Sealing (10-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Qnity introduced Kalrez 7080 perfluoroelastomer parts, a sealing solution engineered for semiconductor processes operating at temperatures up to 330°C, with ultra-low outgassing and extremely low metallic contamination; in internal thermal-aging evaluations over four weeks (672 hours) of air exposure at temperatures up to 325°C the parts demonstrated thermal stability (company evaluation). Target applications: diffusion, oxidation, thermal atomic layer deposition (ALD), metal chemical vapor deposition (CVD) and low-pressure CVD (LPCVD). Kate Dei Cas, President, Semiconductor Technologies: Kalrez sealing solutions show how Qnity translates its fab knowledge into innovations that improve yield and reliability. No customers, volumes or availability dates are named.
quarterly_data.figure: Kalrez 7080 rated up to 330°C; 672 hours at up to 325°C in internal evaluation
